performance.limits: Frozen reference versions; two complete CPU rounds. The adopted allocation change does not establish a stable overall CPU speedup. Memory is excluded from the CPU score.

retainedBoundaries: Explicit async opt-in; ordinary Promise-valued memos keep their meaning.
Native await does not retain reactive tracking or ownership.
Async components and Preview async ownership serialization remain unsupported.
Resource retains cache/transport and refresh policy; prepared effects require pure preparation.
No universal cost optimizer, general region fusion/splitting, arbitrary SSA/Phi rewrites or branch/lifetime-aware memo placement.
The keyed benchmark retains authored selectors, per-row signals and stable captures.
Local Darwin arm64 qualification does not establish remote CI, other platforms, registry publication or deployment.
